project_identity.name: CATTO
project_identity.description: Premium independent fashion & lifestyle e-commerce store (Argentina). Editorial urban aesthetic with high contrast dark identity, bold headlines, layered typography, and strong electric red accents.
project_identity.aesthetic_archetype: Editorial Urban Tech Fashion / Dark Brutalism

responsive.strategy: Design for mobile screens (375px+) first, then scale to tablet (768px) and desktop (1024px+). On mobile, stack all side-by-side elements, enforce high tap targets (min 44px), and collapse filters into slide-over drawers.

layout_reflow.hero: Mobile: Single vertical column with overlay typography at base; Desktop: Asymmetric multi-layer grid with floating image cards.
layout_reflow.product_grid: Mobile: grid-cols-2 gap-3; Tablet: grid-cols-3 gap-6; Desktop: grid-cols-4 gap-8.
layout_reflow.cart_checkout: Mobile: Stacked cart items + sticky bottom checkout bar; Desktop: 2-column layout (items left, summary sticky right).
layout_reflow.admin: Mobile: Stacked stats + scrollable data table with sticky first column; Desktop: 4-column density bento layout.

typography_scale_mobile.hero_h1: text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none
typography_scale_mobile.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight

responsive.tap_targets: min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-center

rules.tinted_greys: Never use pure #000000 or neutral #808080. All dark backgrounds are warm charcoal tinted (#0D0D0F / #121215) and borders are zinc dark (#27272A).
rules.accent_usage: Use Electric Red (#E60023) strictly for key conversion triggers: primary CTAs, sale badges, active filter tab line, cart item counter, floating WhatsApp indicator, and promotional banners.
rules.contrast_compliance: White typography (#FAFAFA) over #0D0D0F guarantees APCA AAA contrast. Red text on dark is minimum 16px bold or enclosed in pill badges.

demo_products.name: Zapatillas Nike SB Dunk Dark Edition

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components follow the dark editorial aesthetic: #0D0D0F background, #FAFAFA typography, and #E60023 electric red accents.

Implement Google Fonts import (@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;700&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Syne:wght@700;800&display=swap');) inside index.css.

Ensure ALL key interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='product-card-prod_1', data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='checkout-transferencia-option').
DO NOT make transparent header over white backgrounds or leave transparent dropdown backgrounds. Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-[#0D0D0F]/90.
All pricing should be formatted in Argentine Pesos (e.g. $145.000,00 ARS or $145.000).
Keep mobile-first responsive design strictly implemented with proper grid steps (2 cols mobile, 4 cols desktop).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: MANDATORY: Every button, link, form input, modal, dropdown, card, and tab MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_headers: Header and overlay menus MUST have bg-[#0D0D0F]/85 or bg-[#121215] with backdrop-blur-xl.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_generic_saas_look: Avoid standard blue/purple gradients, generic rounded white cards, or centered hero text. Use asymmetric dark grid, bold red accents, and high contrast typography.
